page_title: RSO 0-1 BAR | Real Sociedad v Barcelona 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.

90+2' Referee Javier Alberola Rojas points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Barcelona players. It's a goal! Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) bravely launches himself at a cross from Ilkay Gundogan and gives Alex Remiro no chance with a close-range bullet header low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
90+2' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Javier Alberola Rojas is going to take a look using VAR.
90+2' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90+1' Gavi (Barcelona) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Alex Remiro was alert and made a comfortable save.
88' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
86' Gavi (Barcelona) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
86' Javier Alberola Rojas shows a yellow card to Gavi (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
86' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
85' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
84' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal will be replaced by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad).
82' Gavi (Barcelona) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola Rojas stops the game and makes a call.
81' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
79' That's the end of the game for Ander Barrenetxea, who is replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
75' Raphinha (Barcelona) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
75' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a direct free kick.
74' This is a yellow card! Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

73' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.

71' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) picks the ball up and blasts it from long range without any hesitation. His shot is directed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reads it well and makes a fine save. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' The attendance for today's match is 37555.
69' Xavi has decided to substitute Joao Cancelo and he is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joao Felix will be replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
67' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Real Sociedad! Play can continue.

67' There's a break in play and referee Javier Alberola Rojas must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Sociedad using VAR. This could be interesting!
66' PENALTY APPEAL after Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
65' Pedri (Barcelona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
63' Here is a change. Hamari Traore is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
61' Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
60' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola Rojas and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedri (Barcelona) replaces Robert Lewandowski.
57' Xavi has decided to make a change. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replaces Fermin Lopez.
57' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
55' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

54' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen was alert and the score remained the same.
51' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Felix (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) will miss the next game.
49' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Javier Alberola Rojas has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Joao Felix (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
44' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
42' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:0.
39' Joao Felix (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
36' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
35' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
33' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Sociedad.

33' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
32' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) will take a corner kick.
31' Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
31' The ball is cleared after Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
30' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
30' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
25' Real Sociedad are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
22' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
20' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
19' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner.
19' Gavi (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Barcelona will take a corner kick.

16' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen leaps like a salmon to deny him.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Sociedad.
12' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
8' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
7' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
6' Looks like Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
5' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) brings his opponent down. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
3' Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.

3' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Marc-Andre ter Stegen. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
1' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas is introduced as the referee for today's match.
